title: Dan's Lunchroom Moment
recap: Dan could not find a seat in the lunchroom.

slides.text: On Tuesday, Dan picked up his tray and looked for his friends.
He walked toward a table in the lunchroom.
A kid told Dan he could not sit there because they were saving the seat for someone else.
Dan found a different spot and sat by himself.
After school, Dan told his mom what happened at lunch.
